title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with permission to view and edit containers for one label…
description: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 contain an authorization bypass vulnerability where an authenticated user with permission to view and edit containers for one label can access sensitive product data and credentials outside their authorized scope via a slash command in the REST API. This occurs because the product does not enforce authorization checks on related objects accessed by slash commands from an authorized artifact.
